The '''First Battle of Xagobah''' resulted in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|forces]] taking the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Xagobah/Legends|Xagobah]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Republic HoloNet News Core Edition 14:9:04]] of [[Star Wars Insider 70|''Star Wars Insider'' 70]] established that Xagobah fell to the Separatists in 21 BBY.<ref name="Insider" /> ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' placed the Battle of Xagobah as seen in ''[[Boba Fett: A New Threat]]'' and ''[[Boba Fett: Pursuit]]'' in 19 BBY.<ref name="The Essential Reader's Companion">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'' identified this battle as the [[Second Battle of Xagobah]].<ref name="The Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> This establishes the first conflict mentioned in ''Star Wars Insider 70'' as the First Battle of Xagobah.
